summary: Fresh audit against current on-disk state (supersedes prior instance, which cited stale line numbers/SHAs from an earlier revision). File is a pure narrative closer lecture: zero {{prompt:}} markers (expand-md.js confirms no-op), zero fenced student-copied prompt blocks, zero [Skill: ] references. Platform claims (CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md auto-load, subagent rule-inheritance, 5-way parallel subagent fan-out within the 20-agent cap) match check_platform_and_boundaries.md §6d/§6 and are independently backed in the file's own backing block by dated 2026-07-30 checks, several live-probed rather than doc-derived. 5/5 sampled citation URLs (code.claude.com docs + three Every.to Klaassen posts) returned HTTP 200. Citations carry correct source-type labels + freshness stamps in the maintainer/backing block only (not student body, per check_research_claims.md §1's own scope carve-out); the 'plan, work, review, compound' quote is pinned to a verbatim primary-source quote, not a paraphrase. No zombie stats, no denominator-less productivity numbers (the 'week became an afternoon' line is explicitly flagged N=1 in the backing block and stays qualitative in body). check_prompts.md's entire scope does not fire — the compendium's own trigger ('writing ANY prompt block a student copies') never engages on this file. No blocking findings.

platform_claims_checked.claim: Rules in a file Claude Code could read stopped being reminders and became load-bearing. Claude Code opens a session, loads the rules, plans inside them. A subagent dispatched to check a draft starts with them loaded too.
A rule in `./CLAUDE.md` is a thing every session inherits. A rule in a shared checklist is a thing every dispatched subagent is handed before it writes a word.

One person fixing one line became plan mode reshaping a whole file, then a subagent ... auditing that file against a checklist in the background, then four agents in parallel auditing a file against four checklists while a fifth checked the neighbouring files.
The rule sits in `./CLAUDE.local.md`, which is yours. Gitignored, alongside you, read by every future session in this repo.
